source.editorialNote: Industry convention derived by sampling Yonex per-line product pages. Specific 3U averages range from ~85g to ~89g across SKUs; the band 85–89g is the consensus reading. No single Yonex page lists the band itself.

source.name: Yonex Nanoflare 700 Play product page (representative 5U row)
source.editorialNote: Industry convention derived by sampling Yonex per-line product pages. 5U entries publish averages around 75–79g. Verbatim text varies per SKU; this entry is a placeholder until a single Yonex grip & weight reference page is located.

source.name: Yonex grip-size ladder (industry convention)
source.editorialNote: Yonex publishes grip size codes (G2/G3/G4/G5/G6) per product page but does not publish a single grip-size dimension chart at a stable URL. Industry consensus measures G4 at approximately 3 5/8" circumference, with smaller numbers indicating thicker grips. This row stays at Tier 4 until a Yonex grip-dimension reference page is located.

source.name: Yonex grip-size ladder (industry convention)
source.editorialNote: Industry consensus places G5 at approximately 3 1/2" circumference. Same caveat as `yonex-grip-g4-inches`: Yonex does not publish a single dimension chart, so this is Tier 4 derived.
